title: Tunneling.
officialText:
Where pipe is to be installed by tunneling, jacking or a combination of both, the pipe shall be protected from
damage during installation and from subsequent uneven loading. Where earth tunnels are used, adequate supporting st ructures shall
be provided to prevent future settling or caving.
SECTION PC 307
STRUCTURAL SAFETY
